title: Same-day partner recovery approved for platinum traveler
content: Previous LHR-JFK disruption: a platinum traveler with a board-meeting deadline was protected on a Partner Atlantic same-day service even though the additional spend exceeded the default threshold. Approval was granted because the alternative required an overnight stay and would have missed the client commitment.

title: Wheelchair traveler required manual airport coordination
content: A prior wheelchair-assistance passenger could not be auto-rebooked even though seats were available, because airport escort and terminal-transfer support had to be confirmed before the ticket could be reissued.

title: Split-itinerary baggage issue through Boston
content: A previous same-day recovery through Boston produced a baggage misconnect for a premium traveler. Since then, single-connection recoveries with late-evening transfer risk are treated cautiously when a nonstop next-day option exists.
